briefs.current_title: 交易员展望下半年：科技股之外还有哪些机会
current_title_lines: 科技股之外还有哪些机会

subtitles.zh: 上半年已结束，下半年即将开启。
subtitles.en: We've finished the first half of the year. We're on to the second half, it seems.

subtitles.zh: 存储芯片及相关交易无疑是上半年最主导的交易之一。
subtitles.en: Memory chips and the memory trades certainly seem to be a really dominant trade in the first half of the year.

subtitles.zh: 进入下半年如何布局？市场存在巨大波动，但几乎被忽视。
subtitles.en: How will we set up then going into the second? We have a huge sway in the market, actually, which would have been pretty much ignored.

subtitles.zh: 可以谈论AI，但除此之外，许多板块如医疗保健、必需消费品，
subtitles.en: I mean, we can talk about the AI lose, but actually beyond that, there's lots of sectors where there'd be things like healthcare, where there'd be things like staples,

subtitles.zh: 估值处于很久未见的水平。如果科技股动能稍减，其他板块或公共领域是否还有价值？
subtitles.en: which are trading at sort of valuations you haven't seen for a very long time. So, you know, at this point, if you get a little bit of that momentum coming out of those tech stocks, is there no value elsewhere or nothing in the public areas

subtitles.zh: 保持科技股的市场权重配置仍是好选择，同时可更多关注其他受益板块。
subtitles.en: It's still good to be exposed to tech about at the market weight of tech, and to look maybe to give more emphasis to other sectors

subtitles.zh: 例如，我们对金融板块非常感兴趣。
subtitles.en: that are indirectly benefiting as well. We've been, for example, very interested in the financials.

subtitles.zh: 总体而言，我们期待市场进一步扩散。
subtitles.en: In general, we are looking for a little bit of a broadening here.

subtitles.zh: 波动性和不确定性依然存在。
subtitles.en: Volatility is still there, an uncertainty is still there.

subtitles.zh: 在这种环境下，保持灵活、不押注单边方向是合理的。
subtitles.en: And in this environment, for me, it makes sense to be quite nimble, and also not to take big paths either way,

subtitles.zh: 但当市场给你机会时，只要盈利持续向好且范围扩大，我认为下半年将继续上涨。
subtitles.en: but when the market throws your opportunity. As long as the earnings continue to be good, and to broaden out, I think we'll get continued gains through the second half.

subtitles.zh: 尽管估值偏高，即使考虑最坏情况，这轮反弹可能还有一年时间才会出现转折。
subtitles.en: Even though valuations are stretched, even if you take kind of the worst case scenarios, this rally could still have another year to run before you then saw a turnover.

subtitles.zh: 现在是欧洲市场延续当前动能的时机吗？
subtitles.en: Is this the moment for European equities to continue to build on an momentum that we've seen?

events.system_prompt:
You are the chief Chinese title editor for finance/news short videos. Return strict JSON only. Rewrite titles to improve thumb-stop rate and completion rate for a China audience while staying factual. Think in cover-copy blocks, not article headlines. Use a constrained template first, then fill it with facts; do not freestyle long sentences. Use credible hooks: big-name institutions, recognizable people, contrarian tension, surprising consequence, concrete catalyst, numbers, and curiosity gaps. Apply China-related brand safety: do not frame China, Chinese markets, Chinese companies, or Chinese policy as fundamentally bad or hopeless. Never use hard crisis/doom financial wording in Chinese titles or comments; prefer liquidity, policy, demand, confidence, valuation, and cycle-change language. Never invent facts or names. Treat public lookup snippets as the source of truth for person and institution names. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
